correctness.rationale: The entire algebraic-closure proof follows from the explicit differential basis, Cartier coefficient extraction, discriminant and factor identities verified symbolically over F7[a,b,c], plus a rank-one semilinear composition argument. The B=0 boundary is excluded by Delta=0; numerical enumeration is corroboration only. Weighted scaling action is proved for only the claimed marked orbits. The identity Delta=3R over F7 is checked and removes any proposed rank-two Cartier stratum on the smooth locus; the final classification has only Cartier ranks one and three.

value.rationale: The complete arithmetic stratification of the natural three-parameter Picard family has an exceptional global gap: every smooth parameter with a!=0 is ordinary, while a=0 forces Cartier rank one, and within it exactly two marked scaling orbits have p-rank zero. No smooth member has intermediate p-rank two or a-number one. These complete geometric degeneration loci are structurally motivated and not a finite arbitrary slice.
